figurative_meaning_en: Nitpicking over trivial or minor details
similar_in_english: Making a mountain out of a molehill
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনের ছোটখাটো বিষয়ে এঁটোকাঁটার বিচার করো না।
বন্ধুত্বের সম্পর্কে এঁটোকাঁটার বিচার করে লাভ কী?
example_sentences_in_english: Don't nitpick over small things in life.
What's the point of judging friendships on trivial matters?
note: Refers to not being overly particular about household items like utensils when away from home, emphasizing practicality in Bengali daily life.
